synopsis: The corpus identifies UNECE Regulation 171 for Driver Control Assistance Systems (DCAS) as an on-road passenger-car precedent for validating assisted driving, alongside Euro NCAP precedents for AEB and crash avoidance [f1259]. Acceptance under UNECE R171 is determined by type-approval authorities [f1275]. For off-road planning, the corpus cautions that the on-road DCAS and NATM credibility frameworks require adaptation; it does not specify that adaptation in the supplied facts [f5112].

relations.note: Identifies the acceptance authority for the UNECE R171 assisted-driving precedent.
Qualifies the on-road DCAS precedent by requiring adaptation for off-road use.
